word.item: they lit it, it is said
they would go there and hunt, it is said
When they had built a fire (in a certain place) they would go there and hunt.
they would hunt, it is said
Whenever they went there, they would hunt again.
they would go to hunt, it is said
They would go hunting far away in boats.
they would rub it, it is said
They would take (a piece of) flint in each hand and rub them (together).
(it) would be made, it is said
They would make a fire (in that way).
they would make (it), it is said
They (would find) rotten wood in the woods, take a rotten knot (of wood and a piece of) flint, rub them together and make a fire (in that way).
it would (keep) burning, it is said
They would build a fire in a fallen tree (that had) rotted and it would keep burning.
they would kindle (it), it is said
If (their) fire went out, they would go (to the place where) the rotten wood was burning, take (some of) the fire and build a new fire (with it).
when they would rub (them) against each other
it would burn, it is said
When they got somewhere in the woods, they would hunt; when they got there and camped, they would rub (pieces of) flint together and the fire would light.
they would return, it is said
When they had hunted enough, they would return to their homes.
when they squeezed it and twisted it

morph.item: to stretch it out, spread it out

word.item: they would rub it, it is said

When they had thoroughly scraped the deer hide, they dipped it in brain (water), (then) squeezed it and twisted it, (and) when the brains had been thoroughly absorbed by the deer hide, they stretched it and (then) rubbed it (with) a stick.
they would smoke it, it is said

morph.item: to smoke as in a hide

word.item: When (the hide) had been dried, they smoked it.
they would take it, it is said
When it was thoroughly smoked, they took it (and used it).
the would coil it up and twist it, it is said
They would take (deer) brains, make the water a little bit warm, and (mix) the brains thoroughly in the water; then they would take the deer hide and squeeze it and twist it thoroughly in the water.

morph.item: to stretch it out, spread it out

word.item: they would dry it, it is said
When the hide had taken the brains thoroughly, they would stretch (the hide) and dry it.
they would dry it, it is said
When the “soft white tree” bloomed, they would gather the flowers and dry them.
they would drink (it), it is said
When they had boiled them, they would drink (the tea).
they would drink (it), it is said
They would sweeten (the tea with) sugar and drink it.
it would cure (it), it is said
It would cure any kind of fever.
when they stirred (it) in and drank (it)
it would cure (one), it is said
When they had boiled the stinkweed, they would stir in sugar and drink it; it would cure (one).
